nativeScenario.scope: k6 scenario.startTime plus configured native offer duration. Complete requires successful unsignalled process coverage; failed/early-stop stages retain scheduled end without claiming actual completion or an exact stop timestamp.

scope: main attempts are real PUT state changes; pre-phase hydration is outside native workload. Recovery GETs/cost are separate; API invalidate/read/Mark remain in PUT latency

stable.scope: verified positive authoritative relation-version changes between these RR snapshots; configured pool is separate. Failed/unknown phases do not establish complete native participation.

result.unknownScope: classificationUnknown and effectUnknown can overlap during abort sample loss. Distinct unknown is exact only when lower/upper coincide; otherwise unknown=null and bounds remain. Recovery never erases original uncertainty. Zero-unknown requires both counters zero.

downstreamSteadyStateScope: final valid means convergence only; common stage lag/last-minute growth gate must additionally pass for a full-chain capacity claim
